description: This file manages restart procedures for a gateway system, including signaling, process restart commands, and restart coalescing logic. It handles platform-specific restart methods, SIGUSR1 signaling, and restart deferral mechanisms.

classes.name: RestartAttempt
classes.description: Represents the result of a restart attempt, including success status, method used, and details.

classes.name: RestartAuditInfo
classes.description: Contains optional metadata about the restart event, such as actor, device ID, client IP, and changed paths.

classes.name: RestartDeferralHooks
classes.description: Defines callback hooks for the restart deferral process, including deferring, ready, timeout, and error handling.

classes.name: ScheduledRestart
classes.description: Details of a scheduled restart, including process ID, delay, reason, mode, and whether it was coalesced.

methods.name: hasUnconsumedRestartSignal
methods.description: Checks if there is an unhandled restart signal in the current cycle.

methods.name: clearPendingScheduledRestart
methods.description: Clears any pending restart timer and resets related state.

methods.name: summarizeChangedPaths
methods.description: Creates a summary string of changed file paths, limited to a maximum number.

methods.name: formatRestartAudit
methods.description: Formats restart audit information into a string for logging.

methods.name: setPreRestartDeferralCheck
methods.description: Registers a callback to check pending work before restart.

methods.name: emitGatewayRestart
methods.description: Emits a SIGUSR1 signal to trigger a restart, ensuring no duplicate emissions.

methods.name: resetSigusr1AuthorizationIfExpired
methods.description: Resets SIGUSR1 authorization if it has expired.

methods.name: setGatewaySigusr1RestartPolicy
methods.description: Sets whether external restart signals are allowed.

methods.name: isGatewaySigusr1RestartExternallyAllowed
methods.description: Checks if external SIGUSR1 restart is permitted.

methods.name: authorizeGatewaySigusr1Restart
methods.description: Authorizes a restart signal with optional delay.

methods.name: consumeGatewaySigusr1RestartAuthorization
methods.description: Consumes a restart authorization token, returning whether restart is allowed.

methods.name: markGatewaySigusr1RestartHandled
methods.description: Marks the current restart cycle as handled.

methods.name: deferGatewayRestartUntilIdle
methods.description: Polls pending work until idle or timeout, then triggers restart.

methods.name: formatSpawnDetail
methods.description: Formats the result of a spawnSync call into a human-readable string.

methods.name: normalizeSystemdUnit
methods.description: Normalizes a systemd unit name, appending .service if missing.

methods.name: triggerOpenClawRestart
methods.description: Attempts to restart the OpenClaw service using platform-specific methods.

methods.name: scheduleGatewaySigusr1Restart
methods.description: Schedules a SIGUSR1 restart with optional delay and reason, coalescing requests.

methods.name: __testing.resetSigusr1State
methods.description: Resets internal restart signaling state for testing purposes.
